about.metaDescription: Why MessMate exists and how it keeps a shared mess fair.
about.title: Why MessMate
about.lead: A shared mess runs on trust — and on somebody's notebook.
about.p1: Every month, one person in the flat keeps track of who ate what, who bought the bazar and who paid the gas bill. At the end they add it up, and everyone has to take their word for it.
about.p2: MessMate puts that record where the whole mess can see it. Meals, expenses and deposits go in as they happen, and the bill is worked out the same way for everyone.

q1.body: Members and the manager read the same ledger.

q2.title: Meals count as eaten
q2.body: The register holds what people actually ate, not only what they planned.

q3.title: Shared costs, split your way
q3.body: Groceries split by meals; gas, power and khala split equally.

q4.title: Nothing hidden at the end
q4.body: Every bill is itemised, and every money change is logged.

faq.metaDescription: Answers about meal deadlines, half meals, bills and payments.
faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.lead: Still stuck? Write to us from the contact page.

q1.q: When do I have to plan tomorrow's meals?
q1.a: By 11:00 PM the night before, Dhaka time. After that the day locks, and only your manager can change what you ate.

q2.q: Can I eat half a meal?
q2.a: Yes. Meals go in steps of 0.5, so a lunch-only day can be 0.5 or 1.

q3.q: How is my bill worked out?
q3.a: Your meals × the meal rate, plus your share of shared bills and rent, plus next month’s advance and any carried balance, minus your deposits and any bazar you paid for yourself.

q4.a: By card (Stripe) or bKash for the full amount due, or hand cash to your manager, who can record part of it.

q5.q: Does the manager also eat and pay?
q5.a: Yes. The manager lives in the mess too and gets a bill like everyone else.

q6.q: What happens if I leave the mess?
q6.a: You can leave the mess yourself once your bills are paid. Your past bills and payments stay in your account.

q7.q: Can I use it in Bangla?
q7.a: Yes. Switch EN · বাং in the header on any page. MessMate remembers your choice.

q8.a: Your mess sees the mess ledger. Your personal finance entries are visible only to you.
